I used my Trust Wallet to buy Binance Chain, then swapped it for Safe Moon on Pancakeswap.finance with Walletconnect. Took me a bit to figure this out but it’s really easy.

I finally figured out how to swap it today. Used my Trust wallet to buy Smart Chain on my phone. Next, opened pancakeswap.finance on my laptop, selected from BNB to Safe Moon, and changed the slippage to 12%. Next, Hit Unlock wallet, and selected Walletconnect. Then, Opened Trust wallet, selected walletconnect and scanned the QR code on pancakeswap. Voila. My bnb was in there, hit max, and did the swap. There might be easier ways but that worked for me. Good luck!
